controls.procedure: Compare audited execution paths with the canonical repository formatter contract.
controls.expected: Every audited path remains canonical and the aggregate formatter accepts the exact candidate.
controls.observed: Material 5870d275 completed canonical aggregate CI including format validation.

controls.procedure: Require terminal publication to be a result-only child of the final material candidate and restrict paths to audit results.
controls.expected: Later material writes cannot coexist with a ready certificate for an ancestor candidate.
controls.observed: Material 5870d275 is the frozen subject and the handoff guard requires a direct allowlisted result-only child.

controls.procedure: Distinguish device viewport width from content width when scrollbars consume layout space.
controls.expected: Scrollbar consumption cannot be interpreted as a changed device viewport identity.
controls.observed: The exact-head Chrome artifact passed while preserving device/content viewport accounting.

controls.procedure: Check scrollbar accounting together with the independent document horizontal-overflow invariant.
controls.expected: Viewport identity cannot pass by deleting or weakening the document-fit assertion.
controls.observed: The exact-head Chrome artifact passed with independent horizontal-overflow coverage active.

controls.procedure: Freeze only after the final material write and build the result-only handoff from that frozen candidate.
controls.expected: A certificate for an ancestor material candidate is rejected after any later material write.
controls.observed: Material 5870d275 is the final frozen subject used by the current result-only recovery.

controls.procedure: Use the canonical formatter as the discriminant source gate for the final candidate.
controls.expected: A focused visual pass cannot substitute for canonical source formatting on the final candidate.
controls.observed: Material 5870d275 completed aggregate CI including the canonical formatting gate.

controls.procedure: Compare the expected material subject with current-subject markers in the raw critical evidence before accepting the control.
controls.expected: An ancestor presented as current is rejected and the exact subject is accepted.
controls.observed: The generic binding control accepts material 5870d275 and rejects ded93360 when presented as the current subject.

controls.procedure: Verify the SHA-256 of raw critical evidence together with its subject binding before accepting the control.
controls.expected: Modified or mismatched evidence bytes are rejected even when subject text looks current.
controls.observed: The binding control accepts the certified critical-evidence hash and rejects a deliberately incorrect expected hash.
